trainer_long_row_handling: The official Muse Glimmer launcher does not truncate: it rejects the entire run before remote session creation if any rendered row exceeds the local max_seq_len guard. For rows within the guard, it sends all rendered tokens with only standard next-token input/target shift. The 32768 guard preserves all rows; observed train max is 25492.
